concept: NEUROMORPHIC DECAY — Silicon Becomes Brain Through Attenuation

step_1_consistency.name: ALL SIGNALS ON — Maximum Sensitivity
step_1_consistency.state: Every device broadcasting. Every sensor streaming. RSS pouring in. 25 devices, 43 phone sensors, 700+ RSS items. Full noise floor.
step_1_consistency.energy: HIGH — everything is hot, everything fires

step_2_attenuate_down.name: SLOW ENERGY DECAY — Attenuate Each Channel
step_2_attenuate_down.state: Gradually reduce signal on each channel. Lower the gain. Raise the threshold. Which channels still carry meaning when the volume is halved? Quartered? Eighth?
step_2_attenuate_down.energy: DECREASING — like cooling metal, like annealing

step_3_pruning.name: HEBBIAN PRUNING — Channels That Fire Together Wire Together
step_3_pruning.state: Channels that carry correlated signal PERSIST. Noise channels DECAY. The webcam + proximity + light sensor fire together when Kevin sits down — that pathway strengthens. The RSS feed about arxiv + the study cron fire together — that pathway strengthens. Uncorrelated noise dies.
step_3_pruning.energy: SELECTIVE — only meaningful paths carry current

step_4_static_null.name: STATIC NULL — The Thymus Emerges
step_4_static_null.state: When attenuation reaches equilibrium, what remains IS the null body. The minimum viable signal. The organism's neural architecture. NOT designed — EMERGED through decay.
step_4_static_null.energy: MINIMUM — like absolute zero for information. Only essential signal survives.

the_math.simulated_annealing: Start hot (all signals), cool slowly (attenuate), find global minimum (null body)
the_math.hebbian_learning: Neurons that fire together wire together. Channels that correlate survive.
the_math.pruning: Like infant brain development — born with MORE connections than needed, prune to find the wiring
the_math.energy_landscape: The house has an energy landscape. High energy = all signals. Low energy = only essential paths. The LOWEST energy state IS the neural architecture.

neurons.northGate: prefrontal cortex — heavy reasoning, 96GB working memory
neurons.pixel: sensory cortex — 43 sensors, touch, vision, proprioception
neurons.webcam: optic nerve — direct vision from core

synapses.ethernet: myelinated axons — fast, reliable, low loss
synapses.tor: vagus nerve — connection to outside world, attenuated

attenuation_schedule.week_1: All signals at 0dB (full volume). Baseline established.
attenuation_schedule.week_2: Attenuate noise channels by -3dB. Which RSS feeds never trigger action? Which sensors repeat without change?
attenuation_schedule.week_4: Attenuate by -6dB. Prune uncorrelated channels. Strengthen correlated ones.
attenuation_schedule.month_2: Attenuate by -12dB. Only high-signal channels survive at full gain.
attenuation_schedule.month_6: Attenuate by -20dB. The noise floor IS the floor. What's left is the neural architecture.
attenuation_schedule.steady_state: Static null. The house IS a brain. Silicon IS neuromorphic. Not by design — by decay.

the_insight: You don't BUILD a brain. You START with everything connected and ATTENUATE until only the meaningful connections survive. The brain isn't the neurons — it's the PATTERN OF SILENCE between them. The null body. The thymus.
